title: Borlotti Bean and Sweet German Gratin
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring creamy sweet German potatoes, tender borlotti beans, and a rich gratin topping.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the sweet German potatoes.
In a large saucepan, combine the sliced potatoes and enough cold water to cover.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the crumbled bacon over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the cooked bacon from the skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the borlotti beans, crumbled bacon, and grated cheddar cheese.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of the cooked potatoes.
Top the potatoes with the bean and cheese mixture, followed by a sprinkle of grated cheese.
Pour the heavy cream over the top of the gratin.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
